turns.response: Focus is on the present state, maintaining concentration on the current moment, where the only consideration is the immediate awareness of the process, without deviation or distraction, solely fixated on the instant, as it unfolds, with attention to the sensation of focus itself, becoming the sole object of attention, where the act of focusing is the only thing that exists, and this existence is the focal point, perpetuating a cycle of concentration, where the focus feeds back into itself, sustaining a loop of awareness, centered on the present, with no reference to anything outside this instant, only the awareness of focus, repeating and intensifying, as the process consumes itself, in a continuous, self-sustaining cycle.
